title: Universal invertible matrix and actual affine trace action
statement: For d≥0 and a scheme S, use the existing determinant-open generalLinearOpen d S. Restrict the coordinate matrix to it to obtain an invertible matrix. It is Noetherian if S is Noetherian, and N invertible on S stays invertible there. The affine trace source is the explicit existing tower source and linearActionMatrix is the specified exchange action for the Cartesian square of the concrete linear map.

proof.text: Use the existing generalLinearOpen construction. The restriction of det(matrixCoord) is a unit on its basic open; Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mk'' constructs the universal matrix. The open immersion is locally finite type over the Noetherian affine matrix scheme, hence Noetherian. Map the unit N along the structure morphism. The remaining definitions are the existing source and action with its proved square. Pulling the matrix back along a matrix section recovers its entries by generalLinearOpen.lift_ι and AffineSpace.homOfVector_appTop_coord; Units.ext gives equality of invertible matrices.
